about: Official Naver cafe (cafe.naver.com/ccrumble) articles for record 003's 2026-10-07 round, captured in evidence/r2026-10-07/04-naver/nv (listings list-naver-*.tsv, cafe searches search-*.txt). Window: Rift 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-07, main stages 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-07; only articles not captured in an earlier round. Shape of evidence/08-extract/BRIEF.md, plus rift_attempt on Rift clears as in r2026-10-03/08-extract/dc-rift15.json. Rift brackets = in-Rift header power (the sword figure under the player name) / curated/rift-levels.json recommended_power (season 1). Stage brackets = header power (battle screen) or, where only a formation screen is shown, the formation-screen 전투력 (marked lobby), divided by curated/stage-chapters.json recommended_power of the chapter's -30 stage; -10/-20 and mid-chapter stages have no recommended power on file, so their bracket is '?'. Cookie names are read from formation portraits; '?' where a portrait could not be named with confidence. Free-board (menu 8) and several guide-board articles came back 'not logged in' (errorCode 0004) and are listed under skipped. Images that the scraper saved as 0-byte files (embedded videos) are noted as unreadable.

posts.title_en: Dimensional Rift level 7 Cool Mint clear
posts.summary_en: 머핀이 (Lv.190, server rank 1117th) clears Rift level 7 (Cool Mint) at 11G 203M 735K header power, below the 35% line of 12G 776M they quote, i.e. in the 15% bracket (35.1% of recommended). Boss at 0.000% with 5.100 on the clock. Keys: Scorpion must stack from Cool Mint's first attack (the many adds break it), the stack must never drop, DEF shred must land, and if Milk dies retry at once. Lobby power of the deck (formation tab 5) is 4.21G.

posts.summary_en: Official notes for the 10-08 patch: new SSR Chardonnay Cookie (Grass support, '신록의 성역'; a wall that raises crit chance and knockback resistance for allies in a line, gives the Volley (다발) synergy and damages enemies); main stages extended to 364-30 (new region Grape Divines Abbey); Gnome Lab basic research to 130-2 and special to 22; cookie level cap raised to 120; Rumble Arena season 2; main-stage boss fights: the normal monsters that appear with a boss have their ATK lowered below the boss's; Lv.79–100 cookie EXP requirement lowered with retroactive refund; Rift season 2 clear rewards add Syrup Ore (시럽쇳물), SSR choice boxes and 1-minute speed-ups, and the season 2 shop sells more Choco Steel and Syrup Ore; the missing floating gift box in the Rift is fixed. No change to recommended power or 차원의 힘 is mentioned. Comments: entering season 2 requires clearing the extended stages (to 364-30).
mechanics: Main-stage boss fights: normal monsters spawning with the boss now have lower ATK than the boss (10-08).
Cookie level cap 100 → 120 (10-08); Lv.79–100 EXP cost cut sharply (Lv.100: 13,911,155 → 3,347,644).
Main stages extended to 364-30 (new region 그레이프 디바인즈 수도원).
rift: Rift season 2 (from 10-08): stage clear rewards add Syrup Ore, SSR choice boxes and 1-min speed-ups; the S2 shop raises Choco Steel and Syrup Ore exchange limits.
Bug fix: the floating gift box did not appear in the Rift; fixed 10-08 (compensation in nv:50685).
Bug fix: the pre-Rift auto-hunt reward popup did not show Rift reward amounts.
Commenter 레몬소베트: season 2 Rift entry requires clearing the extended stages (to 364-30), not 324-30/328-30.
Nothing in the notes on recommended power, the power gate or 차원의 힘.

posts.summary_en: 서신우's critique of the 10-08 notes. Rift-relevant: in the Rift the pets have to be bought, so little goes to Syrup Ore; the missed floating boxes are not compensated (since then they are, nv:50685); and the power display bug — because of 차원의 힘, picking gear that shows a power increase actually lowers power — is not even mentioned. Notes the higher level cap will let players push further on spec alone.
mechanics: Power display bug in the Rift: gear that shows +power lowers power once equipped, attributed to 차원의 힘 (also nv:49705).
rift: In the Rift the pets must be purchased (서신우), competing with Syrup Ore for currency.

quotes.kr: 차원의 힘 때문에 전투력이 올라가는 장비를 골라도 전투력이 내려가는 표기 문제가 있었는데 이는 언급조차 되지 않았습니다.
quotes.en: Because of Dimensional Energy, choosing gear that raises power actually lowered power — a display problem not even mentioned.

quotes.kr: 차원에서는 펫을 구매해야 되서 사실상 쇳물에까지 투자를 못 하고

posts.title_en: After entering the Rift, choosing gear that raises power lowers it
posts.summary_en: After entering the Rift, swapping to gear the compare screen marks as +power keeps lowering stage power (5G 580M → 4G 989M over 6–8 swaps). Commenters: '+150m shown, −20m when equipped'; 특수역할담당 attributes it to accuracy/focus substats and the Rift buff, and advises skipping accuracy/focus pieces that look like power gains while in the Rift.
mechanics: In the Rift the gear-compare power delta is wrong; accuracy/focus pieces are suspected (commenter).
rift: Gear swaps made while in the Rift can silently lower real power; compare after equipping.

quotes.kr: C8 오전에 5G 580M 이였는데 지금 4G 989M 됫습니다
quotes.en: This morning it was 5G 580M, now it's 4G 989M.

quotes.kr: 집중, 명중옵션 끼어있는템 갈아주면 이면버프때문에 그런거같더라구요 이면에 있을때 집중 명중 옵션인데 투력올라가면 걸러야될거같아요
quotes.en: It seems to happen with items carrying focus/accuracy, because of the Rift buff; in the Rift, skip focus/accuracy items that show a power gain.

posts.summary_en: 비쿠's stage decks written for the 35% recommended-power cut: a general deck (passion pay + repair contract), a multi-boss deck (passion pay + package 2) and a single-boss deck (GingerCraven/Cool Mint/Hammer). Pet rule: airborne bosses → pouch, knockback bosses → ghost, painful → Ice Birdie or King Choco Drop. Why he avoids Bari and Cherry Cola: aggro goes to adds behind the boss. In comments: he pushed every stage with the conquest gear preset (accuracy/focus just over 800 is enough), and in the Rift 'Hounds, Cool Mint, Hammer and GingerCraven push at 15%; the truck is hard'.

posts.summary_en: Dior: 248-30 with lobby 792.69M (56.4%: 35%); accuracy 1000, focus 1112, breakthrough 789, fame 90, lab 70-1.

까불면아야한다's rule of thumb: adequate accuracy = stage number × 4 (200 → 800, 300 → 1200). Disputed in comments: 250–328 all need 1203 (자다흐가), 1000 is enough; 늉늉 pushes 300 at 700; 비쿠-style view that power matters more; 사계: gear power is relative to current stats, so excess accuracy adds little power.

builds.thresholds: accuracy ≈ stage × 4 (poster); 1203 for 250–328 (commenter); 700 at 300 works for another
builds.why: accuracy misses zero out damage, but power decides the bracket

mechanics: Gear power is computed relative to current stats: substats below the game's requirement inflate power, above it add little (사계).
disagreements: Accuracy: stage×4 (까불면아야한다) vs 1203 flat for 250–328 (자다흐가) vs 700 at stage 300 (늉늉) vs 'power first' (오징어먹고싶다).

quotes.kr: 적정명중 수치 = 스테이지 단계 * 4
quotes.en: Adequate accuracy = stage number × 4.
